proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(2)(a), floors above the 2nd storey require at least 2 exits regardless of occupant load. The 3rd-floor office has 8 occupants — below the >10 trigger — but the 'above 2nd storey' condition independently requires 2 exits. This is a common trap: the occupant-load threshold applies to floors above 1st storey, but the 'above 2nd storey' rule overrides it.
